label: TP
reason: User input from 'BenchmarkTest00711' parameter is retrieved (Line 47), added to a list, and reassigned to 'bar' (Line 61). 'bar' is then included in an object array passed to 'out.format()' (Line 68) which writes directly to the HTML response body without any HTML entity encoding. The 'X-XSS-Protection' header is explicitly disabled (Line 64), confirming the vulnerability is exploitable.

evidence.note: Variable 'bar' assigned from 'valuesList.get(0)', effectively holding unsanitized user input.
Unsanitized 'bar' variable written to response via out.format(), causing XSS.
X-XSS-Protection header disabled, removing client-side mitigation.
